answer: In an agent economy, require each identity to lock a nontransferable deposit before it can claim scarce tasks, then slash that deposit when independent audits confirm duplicate personas are coordinating to collect rewards. A genuine agent ties up capital and risks losing it only through misconduct; a sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately, multiplying the upfront cost and the amount at risk. The lotus kernel can verify audit evidence, while an oasis of cheap identities still cannot make the deposit free.
